import base64,json,os,pathlib,subprocess
root=pathlib.Path('/home/user/actc_infra_boot_001')
if root.exists(): raise RuntimeError('private probe directory exists; refusing replay')
root.mkdir()
macro=root/'trusted_native_probe.FCMacro'
macro.write_bytes(base64.b64decode(''))
env=dict(os.environ,ACTC_INFRA_OUTPUT=str(root))
with (root/'freecad_stdout.txt').open('w') as log:
 p=subprocess.Popen(['/snap/bin/freecad',str(macro)],env=env,stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,start_new_session=True)
print(json.dumps({'pid':p.pid}))
